title: Accelerating AI adoption in Europe
summary: OpenAI and Allied for Startups release the Hacktivate AI report with 20 actionable policy ideas to accelerate AI adoption in Europe, boost competitiveness, and empower innovators.
body: OpenAI and Allied for Startups release the Hacktivate AI report with 20 actionable policy ideas to accelerate AI adoption in Europe, boost competitiveness, and empower innovators.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Allied for Startups联合发布了名为Hacktivate AI的报告，提出了20项旨在加速欧洲人工智能应用的政策建议。该报告的核心目标是提升欧洲的科技竞争力并赋能当地创新者，推动生成式AI在政策与产业层面的深度融合。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章探讨了OpenAI与Allied for Startups发布的AI政策报告，对欧洲AI应用具有一定指导意义。
